description: High-quality answer criteria for the Performance Review - Coaching Getting Started interview.

terms.label: Results & Impact
terms.description: Outcomes achieved and the value those outcomes created for customers, teams, or the organization.

terms.label: Execution & Ownership
terms.description: Planning, prioritization, follow-through, accountability, and effective delivery of responsibilities.

terms.label: Quality & Craft
terms.description: Accuracy, completeness, professional standards, and care applied to work products and decisions.

terms.label: Communication & Collaboration
terms.description: Clarity, responsiveness, coordination, trust, and effectiveness when working with others.

terms.label: Judgement & Growth
terms.description: Decision quality, self-awareness, learning, adaptability, development, and readiness for broader responsibility.

responseProfile.stance: Performance consistently falls materially short of expectations.
Performance has meaningful gaps and requires focused improvement.
Performance reliably fulfills the expectations of the role.
Performance significantly and consistently surpasses expectations.

primaryQuestions.question: What are the most important things you’re currently responsible for, and where is most of your time and energy going right now?
answerGuidance: Your current role/title or functional position
The main responsibilities or priorities you are accountable for right now
Which responsibilities consume most of your time and attention
Any temporary projects or short-term priorities currently requiring focus
Any recent shifts in workload, ownership, or expectations
Areas where responsibilities or ownership feel unclear

highQualityCriteria.requirement: States current role/title or functional position.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Lists one or more current responsibilities or priorities.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes each responsibility in concrete, understandable terms.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies which responsibilities consume the most time.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Distinguishes recurring responsibilities from temporary projects.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies any recent shift in priorities or workload.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains why priorities shifted.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Notes any uncertainty in role expectations or ownership.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

primaryQuestions.question: Since the last review or check-in, what progress or wins are you most proud of, and what helped you achieve them?
answerGuidance: Accomplishments, wins, or meaningful progress since the last check-in
What specifically was achieved or improved
Why those accomplishments mattered
Actions you took that contributed to success
Support, collaboration, or resources that helped
Any measurable results, positive outcomes, or lessons learned

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Lists one or more high-value accomplishments.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each accomplishment, describes the accomplishment in detail.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each accomplishment, explains why the accomplishment mattered.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each accomplishment, identifies actions taken that contributed to achieving the accomplishment.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each accomplishment, cites measurable outcomes.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Connects accomplishments to team, customer, or business outcomes.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Notes collaboration or support received from others to achieve accomplishment(s).
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Reflects on repeatable lessons learned while achieving the accomplishment(s).
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

primaryQuestions.question: What is making your work harder than it needs to be right now, and what impact is that having?
answerGuidance: Tools, systems, or processes slowing you down
Workload, interruptions, or competing priorities creating strain
Communication or coordination issues causing friction
Delays, handoff problems, or unclear ownership
How these issues affect speed, quality, or outcomes
Which obstacles would be most valuable to solve first
Any steps you have already taken to improve the situation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Lists one or more obstacles or friction points.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes each obstacle clearly and concretely.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains how each obstacle affects one or more of the following: productivity, quality, or speed.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each obstacle, states whether the obstacle is predominantly a workload, process, tool, or people-related obstacle.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For one or more obstacles, provides an example of where the obstacle caused delays or inefficiency.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides the reasoning for which obstacles are, or were, the most important.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For one or more obstacles, describes any actions already taken personally to improve the situation.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

primaryQuestions.question: What support, clarity, resources, or changes would help you perform at a higher level over the next period?
answerGuidance: Coaching or feedback that would help you improve
Clearer priorities, expectations, or decision-making support needed
Tools, staffing, training, or resources that would help performance
Process changes that would remove friction
Which support needs are most important right now
How this support would improve results

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Lists one or more support, clarity, resource, or change needs in detail.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes each need clearly and concretely.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For each need, explains how having the need met would improve performance.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides the reasoning for which needs are highest priority.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides examples of how satisfying the need will positively impact one or more of the following: personal goals or company objectives.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For one or more needs, notes support already received that has helped.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Distinguishes short-term from long-term support needs.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

primaryQuestions.question: How are communication, feedback, and coordination working between you, your manager, and others you work with?
answerGuidance: How you typically communicate with your manager, peers, or stakeholders
How work is coordinated day to day
What communication practices are working well
Where communication or coordination breaks down
Causes of delays, confusion, or misalignment
Improvements that would help collaboration

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Clearly describes typical communication with their manager addressing one or more of the following: clarity, effectiveness, responsiveness, adaptability, or tone.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Clearly describes typical communication with others, such as co-workers, customers, and contractors, addressing one or more of the following: clarity, effectiveness, responsiveness, adaptability, or tone.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains how work coordination typically happens.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies the elements of their communication that are leading to positive outcomes.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies the elements of their communication that are leading to one or more breakdowns, friction points, or negative outcomes.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Coaching

highQualityCriteria.requirement: For one or more identified breakdowns, friction points, or negative outcomes, explains the causes with examples.

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides one or more examples of how communication affected the outcome positively or negatively.

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides one or more suggestions for how they can improve communication or coordination.

primaryQuestions.question: What skills, experiences, or responsibilities would you like to grow into next, and what would help you get there?

Career growth interests or readiness goals
Why these areas matter to you or your performance
Support, coaching, or opportunities that would help
Any current gaps you need to close first
Which development areas should come first, and why

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides reasoning for why certain development goals should be prioritized over others.

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Establishes a sequence or timeline for addressing development goals.
